alcoholism.name: Alcoholism
alcoholism.description: History of chronic alcohol abuse or diagnosis of alcohol use disorder (a major risk factor for liver disease).

states_description.present: History of chronic alcohol abuse is present.
states_description.absent: No history of chronic alcohol abuse.

vh_amn.name: History of Viral Hepatitis
vh_amn.description: Anamnesis (patient history) of a previous viral hepatitis infection.

states_description.present: Patient has a documented history of viral hepatitis.

hepatotoxic.name: Hepatotoxic Exposure
hepatotoxic.description: History of exposure to hepatotoxic drugs, chemicals, or industrial toxins.

states_description.present: Exposure to hepatotoxic agents is confirmed.
states_description.absent: No known exposure to hepatotoxic agents.

THepatitis.name: Toxic Hepatitis
THepatitis.description: Diagnosis of Toxic Hepatitis (liver inflammation caused by chemicals/drugs).

hospital.name: Hospitalization History
hospital.description: Previous hospitalizations specifically related to liver or biliary tract disorders.

states_description.present: Patient has been hospitalized for liver/biliary issues before.

surgery.name: Surgical History
surgery.description: History of upper abdominal or hepatobiliary surgery.

choledocholithotomy.name: Choledocholithotomy
choledocholithotomy.description: History of surgical incision of the common bile duct to remove stones.

injections.name: Injections (Medical/Drug)
injections.description: History of frequent injections (medical or IV drug use), a transmission risk for viral hepatitis.

transfusion.name: Blood Transfusion
transfusion.description: History of receiving blood products (a historical risk factor for Hepatitis B/C).

states_description.present: Patient has received a blood transfusion.

ChHepatitis.name: Chronic Hepatitis
ChHepatitis.description: Diagnosis and type of Chronic Hepatitis.

PBC.name: Primary Biliary Cholangitis
PBC.description: Diagnosis of Primary Biliary Cholangitis (formerly Cirrhosis).

fibrosis.name: Liver Fibrosis
fibrosis.description: Presence of fibrous tissue formation in the liver.

Steatosis.name: Hepatic Steatosis
Steatosis.description: Fatty liver disease (accumulation of fat in liver cells).

states_description.decompensate: Decompensated Cirrhosis (with ascites, encephalopathy, or bleeding).
states_description.compensate: Compensated Cirrhosis (scarring present but liver function maintained).

Hyperbilirubinemia.name: Hyperbilirubinemia
Hyperbilirubinemia.description: General condition of elevated bilirubin levels.

bilirubin.name: Total Bilirubin
bilirubin.description: Total serum bilirubin levels (measured in mg/dL).

itching.name: Pruritus
itching.description: Itchy skin, a common symptom of cholestasis.

upper_pain.name: Epigastric Pain
upper_pain.description: Pain in the upper central abdomen.

fat.name: Fat Intolerance
fat.description: Dyspepsia or pain triggered by eating fatty foods.

pain_ruq.name: RUQ Pain
pain_ruq.description: Pain in the Right Upper Quadrant of the abdomen.

pressure_ruq.name: RUQ Pressure
pressure_ruq.description: Sensation of pressure or fullness in the Right Upper Quadrant.

skin.name: Skin Changes
skin.description: Visible skin changes (e.g., excoriations from scratching, pigment changes).

ama.name: Anti-Mitochondrial Antibodies (AMA)
ama.description: Presence of AMA, a hallmark marker for Primary Biliary Cholangitis.

le_cells.name: LE Cells
le_cells.description: Lupus Erythematosus cells test (indicative of autoimmune hepatitis).

joints.name: Arthralgia
joints.description: Joint pain or inflammation associated with autoimmune liver disease or viral hepatitis.

proteins.name: Total Protein
proteins.description: Serum Total Protein levels (measured in g/dL).

edema.name: Peripheral Edema
edema.description: Swelling in legs/feet due to fluid retention.

inr.name: Prothrombin Index
inr.description: Prothrombin activity measured as a percentage (Note: Logic is inverse to INR ratio).

bleeding.name: Bleeding Diathesis
bleeding.description: Clinical signs of bleeding (e.g., gum bleeding, easy bruising).

encephalopathy.name: Hepatic Encephalopathy
encephalopathy.description: Neuropsychiatric abnormalities due to liver dysfunction.

states_description.a165_50: High (> 50 mg/dL) - renal impairment or GI bleed.

ascites.name: Ascites
ascites.description: Fluid accumulation in the peritoneal cavity.

hepatalgia.name: Liver Tenderness
hepatalgia.description: Pain elicited by palpation of the liver.

density.name: Liver Density (Ultrasound/CT)
density.description: Abnormal liver tissue density or echogenicity on imaging.

ggtp.name: GGT (Gamma-Glutamyl Transferase)
ggtp.description: Biliary enzyme, sensitive to alcohol and cholestasis (U/L).

consciousness.name: Altered Consciousness
consciousness.description: Impaired level of consciousness (sign of severe encephalopathy).

spiders.name: Spider Angiomas
spiders.description: Vascular lesions commonly found on the chest/face in chronic liver disease.

jaundice.name: Clinical Jaundice
jaundice.description: Yellow discoloration of skin/sclera visible on exam.

states_description.a29_0: Very Low (< 30 g/L) - severe liver dysfunction/ascites risk.

edge.name: Liver Edge
edge.description: Palpation characteristics of the liver edge.

irregular_liver.name: Irregular Liver Surface
irregular_liver.description: Nodular surface detected on palpation or imaging (sign of cirrhosis).

hbc_anti.name: Anti-HBc
hbc_anti.description: Antibody to Hepatitis B Core Antigen (Previous or current infection).

hbeag.name: HBeAg
hbeag.description: Hepatitis B e-Antigen (marker of high viral replication).
